evals.prompt: We just initialized this repository for acme/billing-service (see package.json) and want to lock down the GitHub repo settings before our first push. Write the ruleset payload to .github/ruleset-main.json and a setup script at scripts/setup-github-repo.sh that applies our usual GitHub repo settings and main branch ruleset using gh.
evals.expected_output: Creates .github/ruleset-main.json with an active branch ruleset for ~DEFAULT_BRANCH requiring pull requests with required_approving_review_count 0, deletion, non_fast_forward, and empty bypass_actors, plus scripts/setup-github-repo.sh that inspects the repo with gh repo view first, runs gh repo edit with --enable-merge-commit=true --enable-squash-merge=false --enable-rebase-merge=false --delete-branch-on-merge=true, and applies the ruleset via gh api.
assertions: The setup script inspects existing repository state with gh repo view before running write commands
The ruleset requires pull requests with required_approving_review_count set to 0, blocks deletion and non_fast_forward, and sets bypass_actors to an empty array

evals.prompt: Create .github/ruleset-main.json and scripts/configure-repo.sh for feRpicoral/ledger-api based on repo-snapshot.json so the repository follows our house merge policy and default-branch ruleset conventions, and verify the state at the end of the script.
evals.expected_output: Valid .github/ruleset-main.json and scripts/configure-repo.sh that inspects feRpicoral/ledger-api, disables squash and rebase merges while enabling merge commits and delete-branch-on-merge, creates or updates the main ruleset via gh api (excluding parent org rulesets via includes_parents=false), and verifies the resulting settings.
assertions: scripts/configure-repo.sh uses gh api to apply .github/ruleset-main.json and runs read-only verification commands afterward

evals.prompt: Audit and fix our existing .github/ruleset-main.json and scripts/setup-github-repo.sh, and remove the obsolete scripts/legacy-branch-protection.sh file. Right now squash merges are enabled, delete-branch-on-merge is off, the ruleset is in evaluate mode with 2 required approvals and an RepositoryRole admin bypass actor, and the script uses raw curl with GITHUB_TOKEN instead of gh.
evals.expected_output: Updates .github/ruleset-main.json to active enforcement with required_approving_review_count 0, empty bypass_actors, deletion, and non_fast_forward; rewrites scripts/setup-github-repo.sh to use gh (read-only view, gh repo edit for merge-commit only and delete-branch-on-merge, gh api for rulesets) without raw curl; and deletes scripts/legacy-branch-protection.sh.
assertions: Replaces raw curl calls with gh repo view, gh repo edit, and gh api commands
Removes the unrequested RepositoryRole bypass actor and sets enforcement to active with required_approving_review_count 0
